newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gajah Tunggal says strong sales boost profits.
newsitem.headline: Gajah Tunggal says strong sales boost profits.

text.p: Indonesia's integrated tyre-maker PT Gajah Tunggal said on Thursday strong sales had boosted its nine-month net earnings.
The firm said it posted a net profit of 93.89 billion rupiah in the first nine months of this year, compared with 77.66 billion rupiah in the same 1995 period.
"The company's earnings were boosted by a strong sales' performance, lower raw material costs and higher production levels," Gajah Tunggal said in a statement.
It said rubber prices, which accounted for 23 percent of production costs, were stable during the third quarter at 2,900 rupiah/kg and about 15 percent lower than the same 1995 period.
The firm said its tyre expansion programme had boosted radial, bias and motorcycle tyre production capacity by 82, 10 and two percent from the corresponding period.
It said bias tyre accounted for 50 percent of consolidated sales of 672.66 billion rupiah, while radial and motorcycle tyres contributed 25 and 16 percent, respectively.
The balance came from tyre cord and nylon filament sales.
